title: GP receptionist/Administrator
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a part time receptionist/administrators to join our friendly busy team at Royston Group Practice. Working hours are 14:30 -18:30 Monday to Friday (20 hours). The successful candidate must be flexible to cover sickness/annual leave at short notice The successful candidate will be expected to perform all reception duties including, answering incoming calls and dealing with any queries, booking appointments, ordering of repeat prescriptions, coding letters, booking annual reviews, registering new patients using SystmOne. Greets patients in the facilities and over the phone. Assists doctors, nurses, and patients. Schedules doctors and nurse appointments for patients. Performs clerical and administrative tasks. Coding of clinical letters. Issues repeat prescriptions Maintains and keeps patient information confidential at all times.
